description: This file contains shell functions and procedures for updating boot configuration partitions and performing a firmware upgrade on Sony devices with eMMC storage. It defines functions for modifying boot config partitions and a main upgrade routine that handles partition flashing, formatting, and system reboot.

methods.name: update_bootconfig
methods.description: Updates the boot configuration partition at a specified offset and index. Also updates an alternate boot config partition if it exists.

methods.name: sony_emmc_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the firmware upgrade by flashing kernel and root filesystem partitions, formatting the 'rootfs_data' partition, and optionally backing up configurations.
